name: Sunflower Dance
source:
Sunflower Dance is a Solarpunk Slice of Life. You play as Atlatonan, who is temporarily moving to Granda Oaso, the biggest commune in Gardesta, with the mission to share her culture and learn about Granda Oaso's!

This story takes place in the years 3017 and 3018, civilization has been reborn from the ashes of the Rootoj and has learnt not to destroy the planet anymore. Solar and other clean power sources light up every house using Tesla towers, which also keep everyone connected with a decentralized technology called The Myceliunet! This is the Sun Era! High technology made to last as long as possible can get along with nature, DiY culture driven by a strong sense of self-expression is the norm. After all, if death makes us all equal, then let's enjoy life together!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5460690/]Steam[/url]]
